SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.line_count, o.order_total_gross, o.login_state,
       COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s999_lines
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR COUNT(f.sales_line_id) = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS ids,
 SUM(CASE WHEN status='processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-27' AND DATE '2025-11-29'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order) AS total_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) AS total_ids,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28') AS helsinki_day_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28') AS utc_day_count
